title: BOS-565 the cron form's Zero output confirm, in create and edit mode

scenes.title: the create form shows Zero output between Run setup command and Enabled, defaulted off

steps.caption: Press [c] to open the Scheduled Jobs (cron) list
Press [n] to open the create form
Cron create form visible (focus starts on Name)

steps.type: Post the nightly report to Slack.
steps.caption: Type a prompt
[tab] leaves the Prompt text area (a text area consumes [enter])
[enter] advances to Run setup command — the form scrolls to its run-shape toggles
The Zero output confirm is in view

expect.label: the existing run-shape toggle (the field the new one is modelled on)
the new Zero output confirm is present
the lifecycle toggle that must stay below both run-shape toggles
field ORDER: Zero output renders strictly between Run setup command and Enabled

expect.text: Run with no worktree, branch, or PR
expect.label: the Zero output help text, identical to the web form's

steps.caption: Zero output sits between Run setup command and Enabled, so the two run-shape toggles group above the lifecycle toggle. It renders unselected — the only toggle on this form defaulting off.

scenes.title: the edit form pre-populates Zero output from a job that has it on

steps.caption: Leave the create form, back to the cron list
Move to row 5 — 'Morning PR triage', the one demo job with is_zero_output set
Press [enter] to edit the highlighted job
Cron edit form visible, pre-populated (focus starts on Name)
[enter] advances to Run setup command — the form scrolls to its run-shape toggles
The Zero output confirm is in view, pre-populated from the job

expect.label: the edit form's title/name field shows 'Morning PR triage' — the one demo job with is_zero_output set, so opening any other row fails here
the Zero output confirm is present in edit mode too
the confirm renders its affirmative option; the still shows Yes highlighted, pre-populated from job.IsZeroOutput

steps.caption: Editing 'Morning PR triage' (is_zero_output = true) pre-populates the Zero output confirm affirmative — the still shows Yes highlighted, where every other demo job renders No.
